name: TwoPlan
description: Project management: Space → Project (KEY) → epics, milestones and tickets. Kanban/table/timeline views, sub-tasks, checklists, links, custom fields, saved views, docs, dashboards, inbox, CSV/Linear import. Workspace-level access.

endpoints.name: listProjects
endpoints.description: Lists projects in the workspace (optionally one space). Workspace members see every space and project.

endpoints.name: createProject
endpoints.description: Creates a project inside a space with a unique key (tickets become KEY-1, KEY-2, …). Seeds the default workflow, or copies a project template's configuration.

endpoints.name: getProject
endpoints.description: One project by id or key.

endpoints.name: updateProject
endpoints.description: Renames or reconfigures a project (feature toggles, estimate kinds). The key is immutable.

endpoints.name: archiveProject
endpoints.description: Archives (or restores, with restore=true) a project.

endpoints.name: deleteProject
endpoints.description: Permanently deletes a project and everything in it.

endpoints.name: listProjectTemplates
endpoints.description: Project templates of the workspace.

endpoints.name: saveProjectAsTemplate
endpoints.description: Snapshots a project's statuses, types, labels, custom fields, settings and ticket templates into a reusable project template.

endpoints.name: deleteProjectTemplate
endpoints.description: Deletes a project template (projects created from it are unaffected).

endpoints.name: getProjectStats
endpoints.description: Aggregates for dashboards: tickets by status / priority / assignee / type / epic and recent created-vs-completed counts.

endpoints.name: listStatuses
endpoints.description: Lists statuses of a project, ordered by position.

endpoints.name: createStatus
endpoints.description: Creates a status in a project.

endpoints.name: updateStatus
endpoints.description: Updates a status.

endpoints.name: deleteStatus
endpoints.description: Deletes a status.

endpoints.name: listTicketTypes
endpoints.description: Lists tickettypes of a project, ordered by position.

endpoints.name: createTicketType
endpoints.description: Creates a tickettype in a project.

endpoints.name: updateTicketType
endpoints.description: Updates a tickettype.

endpoints.name: deleteTicketType
endpoints.description: Deletes a tickettype.

endpoints.name: listLabelGroups
endpoints.description: Lists labelgroups of a project, ordered by position.

endpoints.name: createLabelGroup
endpoints.description: Creates a labelgroup in a project.

endpoints.name: updateLabelGroup
endpoints.description: Updates a labelgroup.

endpoints.name: deleteLabelGroup
endpoints.description: Deletes a labelgroup.

endpoints.name: listLabels
endpoints.description: Lists labels of a project, ordered by name.

endpoints.name: createLabel
endpoints.description: Creates a label in a project.

endpoints.name: updateLabel
endpoints.description: Updates a label.

endpoints.name: deleteLabel
endpoints.description: Deletes a label.

endpoints.name: listCustomFields
endpoints.description: Lists customfields of a project, ordered by position.

endpoints.name: createCustomField
endpoints.description: Creates a customfield in a project.

endpoints.name: updateCustomField
endpoints.description: Updates a customfield.

endpoints.name: deleteCustomField
endpoints.description: Deletes a customfield.

endpoints.name: listCustomFieldOptions
endpoints.description: Options of a `select` custom field.

endpoints.name: createCustomFieldOption
endpoints.description: Adds an option to a `select` custom field.

endpoints.name: updateCustomFieldOption
endpoints.description: Renames / recolors / reorders a custom-field option.

endpoints.name: deleteCustomFieldOption
endpoints.description: Deletes a custom-field option.

endpoints.name: getProjectConfig
endpoints.description: Everything the UI needs to render a project in one round trip: statuses, ticket types, label groups, labels, custom fields with options.

endpoints.name: listTickets
endpoints.description: Lists tickets of a project with filters, sorting and pagination. Sub-tasks are included unless parentId=none.

parentId.description: parent ticket id or 'none' for top-level only

q.description: title substring or identifier like PLAN-12

endpoints.name: createTicket
endpoints.description: Creates a ticket (identifier KEY-n from the project's atomic counter). Defaults to the project's first backlog/todo status. Sub-tasks are one level deep. `templateId` pre-fills from a ticket template.

endpoints.name: getTicket
endpoints.description: Full ticket detail by id or identifier (PLAN-12): relations (epic, milestone, parent, sub-tasks), labels, custom-field values, links, dev links, checklists, watchers, attachments and comments.

endpoints.name: updateTicket
endpoints.description: Updates any ticket field (including labels, status, epic, milestone, parent). Every change is written to the activity feed and notifies watchers.

endpoints.name: archiveTicket
endpoints.description: Archives (or restores, restore=true) a ticket; archived tickets are hidden from boards and lists.

endpoints.name: deleteTicket
endpoints.description: Permanently deletes a ticket. Its sub-tasks are detached (become top-level), not deleted.

endpoints.name: bulkUpdateTickets
endpoints.description: Applies one patch (status, assignee, priority, epic, milestone, labels to add/remove) or archive/delete to many tickets at once.

endpoints.name: createComment
endpoints.description: Adds a comment (markdown/HTML from the editor). The author auto-watches the ticket; watchers are notified.

endpoints.name: updateComment
endpoints.description: Edits your own comment.

endpoints.name: deleteComment
endpoints.description: Deletes your own comment.

endpoints.name: listTicketActivity
endpoints.description: Chronological activity feed (field changes, comments, created/archived).

endpoints.name: watchTicket
endpoints.description: Subscribes (watching=true) or unsubscribes the caller to a ticket's notifications.

endpoints.name: createChecklist
endpoints.description: Adds a checklist to a ticket.

endpoints.name: updateChecklist
endpoints.description: Renames or reorders a checklist.

endpoints.name: deleteChecklist
endpoints.description: Deletes a checklist and its items.

endpoints.name: createChecklistItem
endpoints.description: Adds an item to a checklist.

endpoints.name: updateChecklistItem
endpoints.description: Edits, toggles (done) or reorders a checklist item.

endpoints.name: deleteChecklistItem
endpoints.description: Deletes a checklist item.

endpoints.name: createTicketLink
endpoints.description: Links this ticket to another one in the same workspace: blocks (this blocks target), relates_to, duplicates (this duplicates target).

endpoints.name: deleteTicketLink
endpoints.description: Removes a ticket link.

endpoints.name: setTicketFieldValue
endpoints.description: Sets (or clears with value=null) a custom-field value. Validated against the field type; select values must be an option id.

endpoints.name: createDevLink
endpoints.description: Attaches a pull request / branch / commit URL with its state and CI status (set manually or by an external caller).

endpoints.name: updateDevLink
endpoints.description: Updates a dev link's title, state or CI status.

endpoints.name: deleteDevLink
endpoints.description: Removes a dev link.

endpoints.name: uploadAttachment
endpoints.description: Uploads a file as the raw request body (Content-Type = file type). Query: ?fileName=<name>. Max 25 MB.

endpoints.name: downloadAttachment
endpoints.description: Downloads an attachment (binary).

endpoints.name: deleteAttachment
endpoints.description: Deletes an attachment and its blob.

endpoints.name: createEpic
endpoints.description: Creates a epic in a project.

endpoints.name: updateEpic
endpoints.description: Updates a epic.

endpoints.name: deleteEpic
endpoints.description: Deletes a epic.

endpoints.name: listEpics
endpoints.description: Epics of a project with ticket progress rollups and labels.

endpoints.name: createMilestone
endpoints.description: Creates a milestone in a project.

endpoints.name: updateMilestone
endpoints.description: Updates a milestone.

endpoints.name: deleteMilestone
endpoints.description: Deletes a milestone.

endpoints.name: listMilestones
endpoints.description: Milestones (sprint-like, time-boxed) with progress and a derived state: upcoming | active | completed.

endpoints.name: getEpic
endpoints.description: One epic with progress and labels.

endpoints.name: setEpicLabels
endpoints.description: Replaces an epic's labels.

endpoints.name: completeMilestone
endpoints.description: Finishes a milestone early (sets completedAt; endDate stays the planned date). With moveOpenTo, unfinished tickets roll over to another milestone (or to none with moveOpenTo=null). reopen=true clears completion.

endpoints.name: getTimeline
endpoints.description: Data for the timeline (gantt) view: epics, milestones and dated tickets with their date ranges, grouped by epic. Tickets without any date are omitted.

endpoints.name: listViews
endpoints.description: Lists views of a project, ordered by position.

endpoints.name: createView
endpoints.description: Creates a view in a project.

parentId.description: parent ticket id or 'none' for top-level only

q.description: title substring or identifier like PLAN-12

endpoints.name: updateView
endpoints.description: Updates a view.

parentId.description: parent ticket id or 'none' for top-level only

q.description: title substring or identifier like PLAN-12

endpoints.name: deleteView
endpoints.description: Deletes a view.

endpoints.name: listDocuments
endpoints.description: Lists documents of a project, ordered by position.

endpoints.name: createDocument
endpoints.description: Creates a document in a project.

endpoints.name: updateDocument
endpoints.description: Updates a document.

endpoints.name: deleteDocument
endpoints.description: Deletes a document.

endpoints.name: listDashboards
endpoints.description: Lists dashboards of a project, ordered by position.

endpoints.name: createDashboard
endpoints.description: Creates a dashboard in a project.

endpoints.name: updateDashboard
endpoints.description: Updates a dashboard.

endpoints.name: deleteDashboard
endpoints.description: Deletes a dashboard.

endpoints.name: listTicketTemplates
endpoints.description: Lists tickettemplates of a project, ordered by position.

endpoints.name: createTicketTemplate
endpoints.description: Creates a tickettemplate in a project.

endpoints.name: updateTicketTemplate
endpoints.description: Updates a tickettemplate.

endpoints.name: deleteTicketTemplate
endpoints.description: Deletes a tickettemplate.

endpoints.name: setDocumentTickets
endpoints.description: Replaces the tickets a document is linked to.

endpoints.name: listTicketDocuments
endpoints.description: Documents/notes linked to a ticket.

endpoints.name: getDocumentTickets
endpoints.description: Ticket ids a document is linked to.

endpoints.name: listNotifications
endpoints.description: Caller's inbox, newest first. unread=true filters to unread.

endpoints.name: markNotificationsRead
endpoints.description: Marks the given notifications (or all, with all=true) as read.

endpoints.name: listMyTickets
endpoints.description: Open tickets assigned to the caller across all projects in the workspace (or tickets they watch, with scope=watching).

endpoints.name: searchWorkspace
endpoints.description: Command-palette search: projects (name/key), tickets (title or identifier) and epics (title) across the whole workspace.

endpoints.name: getPreference
endpoints.description: Reads a per-user UI preference (opaque JSON).

endpoints.name: setPreference
endpoints.description: Writes a per-user UI preference.

endpoints.name: createShareLink
endpoints.description: Creates a read-only public link for a project board, or for a single ticket (ticketId). The token is the only credential.

endpoints.name: listShareLinks
endpoints.description: Active share links of a project.

endpoints.name: revokeShareLink
endpoints.description: Revokes a share link immediately.

endpoints.name: getPublicShare
endpoints.description: Public, unauthenticated, read-only view for a share token: project board (statuses + tickets) or a single ticket with comments and checklists. No user ids are exposed.

endpoints.name: exportTickets
endpoints.description: Exports a project's tickets (honouring the listTickets filters) as CSV (default) or JSON. Names, not ids, so the file round-trips through importTicketsCsv.

endpoints.name: importTicketsCsv
endpoints.description: Imports tickets from CSV text. Header row required; recognised columns: title (required), description, status, type, priority, assignee, epic, milestone, labels (| separated), points, estimateMinutes, startDate, dueDate. Status/type/epic/milestone are matched by name; unknown labels and epics are created. Rows that fail are reported, the rest import.

endpoints.name: importFromLinear
endpoints.description: One-shot import of a Linear team: workflow states -> statuses (by name, created if missing), labels, issues (priority/estimate/dates/parent), Linear cycles -> milestones, Linear projects -> epics. The API key is used for this request only and never stored. Re-running skips nothing, so import into a fresh project.
